page.content:
The Dragon of LIJ who moved from junior king to heavyweight.

How Shingo Takagi connects

  • Faction: Los Ingobernables de Japón — Shingo Takagi is LIJ's heavyweight dragon.
  • Item: NEVER Openweight Championship — Shingo's New Japan rise ran through the NEVER Openweight Championship.

What is Shingo Takagi?

Shingo Takagi crossed from Dragon Gate into LIJ, won the NEVER Openweight Championship, and later chased the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship as Naito's heavyweight enforcer.

Key threads lead to Los Ingobernables de Japón and NEVER Openweight Championship.
